svg.title: The approval page for a commitment purchase, with its parts numbered
svg.desc: An invented example of the approval page for a one-year compute savings plan. It shows the address and plan code, a title with a verb and an object, who must approve, what changes, what it saves, what could go wrong, that it cannot be undone, a check-your-answers summary, the buttons and the footer.
svg.text: https://cost-in-action.contoso.example/ok/r_Hn4c7T…
Cost in Action (AI)
Signed in as Lars (finance approver)
Buy a one-year compute savings plan for the order
platform
This needs two people, each on their own. You are one of them (finance).
You will not see the other answer, or any note, until you have given yours.
What changes
Buys
One-year compute savings plan, USD 25.00 an hour (USD 219,000 in total)
In euro
About €205,860 at 0.94 euro to the dollar. An estimate: your approval binds the dollar amount
Payment
Monthly, about €17,155 as invoiced for 12 months; the amount follows the exchange rate
Benefits
Management group Order platform (mg-order-platform)
Subscriptions a1f0-0001, a1f0-0002 and a1f0-0003 today
A later member also benefits if it is on billing profile BP-ORD-01
Paid by
Subscription a1f0-0001 (Order platform prod 1), billing profile BP-ORD-01 (Contoso Orders)
Renews
No: auto-renew is off
When
On approval. The purchase uses the price check stored on Thursday 09:12 CEST
Made by
A separate system. The AI that wrote this Recommendation cannot buy anything
What it saves
About €4,300 a month
At your agreement's rates
Expected saving
Range €3,700 to €4,900, amortised. Each hour's benefit is lost if unused. Until 30 June the current
reservation covers part of this usage: the plan then saves about €700 a month, and about USD 4,500 a
month of the commitment goes unused. From 1 July it saves about €4,300 a month, so waiting past then
forgoes about €140 a day.
What could go wrong
The strongest reason I might be wrong: usage can drop below the commitment after the planned
migration in March. I will check utilisation every month and tell you if it falls below 90%.
This cannot be undone. A savings plan cannot be cancelled, refunded or exchanged.
Open the evidence (a link to its own page: your last 12 months checked against this plan, 94 to 97 % used)
Who else
Two people approve this, each on their own. The other answer is shown after you have both decided.
Check before you approve
Buy a one-year compute savings plan at USD 25.00 an hour for the order platform.
USD 219,000 in total (about €205,860), paid monthly. It cannot be cancelled, refunded or exchanged.
Plan code K4M8-R6TW
Approve this exact purchase
Decline
Ask or suggest
Not mine
Plan code K4M8-R6TW, the same as on your Teams card. Expires Thursday 10 June, 09:00 CEST; a later decision gets a fresh price check.
Why you are seeing this
Talk to a person
Written by an AI. Figures are computed by tools, not guessed by the AI. Estimates can still be wrong.
Address and plan code
One address for every approval, named in the announcement.
The plan code is a reference, not a secret: it is echoed
on every submit, and each approver records one decision
against it. A stale plan, or a person who is not the
designated approver, is refused; a forwarded link
authorises nobody, but the designated approver may use it
after signing in.
Title: verb, object, place
It says what will happen, not what the AI feels. The same
words are on the button.
Who must approve
The class in plain words, and what you will and will not
see of the other approver's answer.
What changes
The exact change in the currency it is bought in, the euro
estimate and its rate, what benefits and who pays, when,
and who makes it. The AI that wrote the Recommendation is
not that actor.
What it saves
A range, the price basis and the saving word, and what
keeping things as they are forgoes, said only for the time
it is true.
What could go wrong
Always visible for a change of this size. It carries the
strongest objection, not a reassurance.
Cannot be undone
Said once, in words, before the button. A change that can
be undone says how long the window stays open.
Who else
Two independent approvers, asked in parallel. Each sees
the same plan and evidence; neither sees the other answer
until both have decided. One person cannot fill both
roles.
Check before you approve
The whole decision in three lines.
Buttons
The first button repeats the action. All four are the same
size. Decline takes one tap and an optional reason on a
second page. Ask or suggest sends a question or another
way back; nothing is approved. Without script each button
is a form post that carries the plan code.
Footer
Expiry with a time zone, why you are seeing this, a person
to talk to, and the AI line.
